<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="ecmascript" initial="s">
  <datamodel>
    <data id="_" expr="1"/>
    <data id="x" expr="1"/>
  </datamodel>
  <state id="s">
    <transition event="e" cond="_ > 0" target="f"/>
  </state>
  <final id="f"/>
</scxml>

notes: SCXML reserves names that begin with `_` for system variables such as `_event`, `_sessionid`, `_name`, and `_ioprocessors`, and a conformant document declares no data with such an id
diagnostics.help: rename the data without the leading `_`, and update every reference to it
